title: Recognition Cluster Top Unlabeled Response
description: WordPress recognition proxy envelope for the top-unlabeled naming queue.

clusters.description: Top unlabeled clusters returned by GET /recognition/clusters/top-unlabeled.

identity_count.description: Observed member-row count when the representative preview is not truncated. When the preview is truncated, identity_count = max(projected, representatives.length). Always identity_count >= representatives.length.

representatives.description: Preview of observed members (cap 4). Non-empty for top-unlabeled queue rows. identity_count reflects observed members when this array is shorter than the preview cap.

limit.description: Maximum number of clusters requested for the naming queue response.

total.description: Pre-filter qualifying unlabeled cluster count (COUNT(*) OVER()). Mapper/proxy drops set repair_pending and do not shrink total.

truncated.description: Whether additional unlabeled clusters exist beyond this response. Paging only — invariant filtering does not set this flag.

repair_pending.description: True when this response requested targeted projection repair or dropped invariant-failing rows. Drives the review-queue Resync affordance.

singleton_count.description: Count of singleton clusters omitted from the naming queue when projection data is available.

data_source.description: Source of the naming queue response envelope.

projection_status.description: Projection bootstrap state when the response depends on local sync status.
